scenes.vo: Batters, getting bowled through the gate again?

scenes.label: Foot across ✗
scenes.vo: Slow it down. Your front foot goes across, not to the ball.
Film from the batting front spot to see it.
Head leads. Step to the line of the ball. Bat comes down by the pad.

scenes.label: Foot to ball ✓
scenes.vo: Now the foot goes to the ball.
Next net, gate closed, right off the middle.
Follow Crease Cam for the launch.
